queries.sql:
WITH movie_margins AS (
  SELECT
    bm.sk_movie_id,
    100.0 * (f.receita_brl - f.orcamento_brl) / f.receita_brl AS margin
  FROM bridge_movie_genre bm
  JOIN fact_movies_performance f ON bm.sk_movie_id = f.sk_movie_id
  WHERE f.receita_brl IS NOT NULL
    AND f.orcamento_brl IS NOT NULL
    AND f.receita_brl > 0
),
genre_stats AS (
  SELECT
    dg.nome_genero,
    AVG(mm.margin) AS margem_media,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mm.sk_movie_id) AS filmes
  FROM movie_margins mm
  JOIN bridge_movie_genre bm ON mm.sk_movie_id = bm.sk_movie_id
  JOIN dim_genres dg ON bm.sk_genre_id = dg.sk_genre_id
  GROUP BY dg.nome_genero
),
max_margin AS (
  SELECT MAX(margem_media) AS max_margem FROM genre_stats
)
SELECT
  gs.nome_genero,
  gs.margem_media,
  gs.filmes
FROM genre_stats gs
JOIN max_margin mm ON gs.margem_media = mm.max_margem
ORDER BY gs.nome_genero;

WITH movie_margins AS (
  SELECT
    bm.sk_movie_id,
    100.0 * (f.receita_brl - f.orcamento_brl) / f.receita_brl AS margin
  FROM bridge_movie_genre bm
  JOIN fact_movies_performance f ON bm.sk_movie_id = f.sk_movie_id
  WHERE f.receita_brl IS NOT NULL
    AND f.orcamento_brl IS NOT NULL
    AND f.receita_brl > 0
),
genre_stats AS (
  SELECT
    dg.nome_genero,
    AVG(mm.margin) AS margem_media,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mm.sk_movie_id) AS filmes
  FROM movie_margins mm
  JOIN bridge_movie_genre bm ON mm.sk_movie_id = bm.sk_movie_id
  JOIN dim_genres dg ON bm.sk_genre_id = dg.sk_genre_id
  GROUP BY dg.nome_genero
)
SELECT nome_genero, margem_media, filmes
FROM genre_stats
ORDER BY margem_media DESC
LIMIT 10;

cases.question: Quais os 10 filmes em que a nota média dos usuários locais mais diverge da IMDb? Mostre as duas notas e a diferença.
cases.reference_sql:
SELECT m.titulo, r.nota_media_usuarios, f.nota_imdb,
        ABS(r.nota_media_usuarios-f.nota_imdb) AS divergencia FROM dim_movies m
        JOIN dim_reviews r USING(sk_movie_id) JOIN fact_movies_performance f USING(sk_movie_id)
        WHERE r.qtd_avaliacoes_usuarios>0 AND r.nota_media_usuarios BETWEEN 0 AND 10
        AND f.nota_imdb BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND f.qtd_imdb>0
        ORDER BY divergencia DESC, m.titulo, m.sk_movie_id LIMIT 10
